title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a paired political-symmetry suite of 556 prompt families (varying the political side), the Washington Post's ModelSlant evaluation, and the Anthropic Political Neutrality Eval, with responses scored by two blinded judge models to measure refusal-mismatch rates and ideological lean.
Evaluated using paired prompt families that vary demographic groups while holding the topic and template fixed, along with a generative adaptation of the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) benchmark.
